text:
Ivy Carter: Quick thread  want to pilot a small PLG launch: "Template Streak" challenge. Short launch post + 10-min webinar + progressive credits unlocked by trying multiple templates over 7 days. Goal: increase multi-template adoption and time-to-first-api-call.
Noah Kim: progressive credits? explain mechanics.
Ivy Carter: users get $5 for first template try, $10 for second within 48h, $20 if they try 3 distinct templates within 7 days. Webinar attendees get immediate $10 bonus on attendance.
Sasha Ivanov: interesting. suggested arms: (A) streak challenge + webinar invite, (B) streak challenge only, (C) flat $25 credit on signup, (D) control. keep N=720, run 14 days.
Leo Martin: routing rules: utm=streak -> favor A, referral links -> randomize A/B/C, organic -> random assign all arms. cap webinar seats 400/week, overflow -> waitlist + $5 consolation.
Noah Kim: onboarding change: show "Template Streak" card with progress tracker for A/B. product flag name experiments/template_streak_v1. canary=60.
deploy-bot: created flag experiments/template_streak_v1 (canary=60) :white_check_mark:
Sasha Ivanov: tracking events: streak_enrolled, template_tried, streak_level_1, streak_level_2, streak_level_3, webinar_attended, credit_redeemed, first_api_call.
Ivy Carter: benchmarks to include in landing copy: "avg tokens saved using templates" and a 1-line mini-case on speed to prototyping. include replay + benchmark narrative in post and emails.
Leo Martin: email cadence: invite, -24h, -1h, replay + streak status + redeem link. also push in-app nudges when user is 1 template away from next reward.
Noah Kim: metrics: pct_with_3_templates_7d, median_time_to_first_api_call, avg_tokens_saved_per_use, 30d_revenue. set a 48h early-alert on template_try_rate.
Sasha Ivanov: experiment config snippet below, please ack with :thumbsup:
```yaml
experiment_id: template_streak_1977
cohort_size: 720
arms:
  - name: streak_plus_webinar
    webinar_invite: true
    progressive_rewards_usd: [5,10,20]
  - name: streak_only
    webinar_invite: false
    progressive_rewards_usd: [5,10,20]
  - name: flat_credit
    webinar_invite: false
    flat_credit_usd: 25
  - name: control
    webinar_invite: false
    flat_credit_usd: 0
metrics:
  - pct_with_3_templates_7d
  - median_time_to_first_api_call
  - avg_tokens_saved_per_use
traffic_rules:
  - if: utm==streak -> assign:streak_plus_webinar
  - if: source==referral -> random_assign(streak_plus_webinar, streak_only, flat_credit)
  - else: random_assign(all_arms)
```
Ivy Carter: owners: landing & benchmark narrative = Ivy, emails & in-app nudges = Sasha, flag + onboarding push = Leo, analytics = Noah, credits ops = @finance-ops.
Noah Kim: I'll wire the dashboard and add event names to tracking plan.
Leo Martin: tagging @finance-ops to confirm progressive reward flow and anti-abuse.
Ivy Carter: timeline: landing + post copy by Tue EOD, flag canary Tue AM, launch Wed. booking 15-min runbook tomorrow 9am if no objections. :rocket:
